description_en: Unbinds an application instance from a user
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center unbind --product-type CloudApp --app-instance-group-id aig-e1l4kqqykxt4uzdx9 --login-token v1e9c8e83d83ea11270871640059145702bde8c5be8c6b9a854ffb6a43bd2673c19a5551c83800724e024f488dbfb0b247 --session-id 11040139-4fb4-4b35-9b44-6c07c746a43e --api-version 2021-09-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Unbind

parameters.help_en: The product type. The value must be `CloudApp`, which indicates a cloud application product
parameters.help_zh: 产品类型，取值仅可为`CloudApp`，表示云应用产品
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application instance group
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application instance
parameters.name: app_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the application.
Obtain this ID by calling the ListPublishedAppInfo operation
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。
通过ListPublishedAppInfo接口获取
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The username of the convenience account
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The operating system of the client
parameters.name: client_os

parameters.help_en: The unique ID that is generated by the client
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the client
parameters.name: client_version

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the client
parameters.name: client_ip

parameters.help_en:
The logon token.
Obtain this token by calling the GetLoginToken operation. You can also refresh the token by calling the RefreshLoginToken operation. The token is the value of the returned \`LoginToken\` parameter
parameters.help_zh:
登录凭证。
通过GetLoginToken接口登录获取，或登录后通过更新接口RefreshLoginToken获取。返回参数：LoginToken
parameters.name: login_token

parameters.help_en:
The session ID.
Obtain this ID by calling the GetLoginToken operation. The ID is the value of the returned \`SessionId\` parameter
parameters.help_zh:
会话ID。
通过登录接口GetLoginToken获取，返回参数：SessionId
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
Obtain this ID by calling the GetLoginToken operation. The ID is the value of the returned \`TenantId\` parameter
parameters.help_zh:
租户 ID。
通过登录接口GetLoginToken获取，返回参数：TenantId
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of AppStream Center
parameters.name: login_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the persistent session
parameters.name: app_instance_persistent_id
